result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards back-to-back, which looks like duplicated/placeholder data rather than distinct restaurants.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' row displays two consecutive cards with the exact same name ('Green Bowl Poké'), identical thumbnail image, identical delivery time (15–25 min) and identical delivery fee (€0.90). This appears to be duplicated or placeholder data, making the carousel look broken or unpolished.
issues.suggestion: Populate the carousel with distinct restaurants/dishes. If the same restaurant legitimately appears twice, differentiate the cards (e.g., different dish image or subtitle) or deduplicate the entries.

issues.description: The two 'Green Bowl Poké' cards use a flat light-gray placeholder background while the neighboring 'Smash Bros' card uses a rich photographic background, creating visual inconsistency within the same carousel.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent, high-quality imagery for all carousel cards so the row looks uniform and intentional.
